newsitem.title: USA: INTEL FILES COUNTERSUIT AGAINST DIGITAL.
newsitem.headline: INTEL FILES COUNTERSUIT AGAINST DIGITAL.

text.p: Intel Corp said Tuesday it filed a lawsuit against Digital Equipment Corp claiming violation of 14 Intel patents.
The move is the latest volley in a legal row between the two companies over patented technologies.
In May Digital filed suit against Intel, claiming it had stolen key elements of patented technology for the design of Intel's popular Pentium processors.

Intel's countersuit claims that Digital infringed patents covering microprocessor architecture and design, semiconductor manufacturing, video encoding/decoding, thermal management for portable systems, system architecture and design, and system service and management.
Digital was not immediately available for comment.
Intel's stock was up 1-3/8 at 97-7/16 Tuesday afternoon. Digital rose 1-7/8 at 46-3/4.
